reading.action: Strike the leeches with the rod while breaking for dry footing
reading.gate: x0.3 in-water (can't cut water; swarm re-pools)
reading.result: CHIP — heated bar crushes/sears some leeches (Glut 74->60) but the mass re-coheres in the flood. Brute-swinging in water is a near-no-op by design; low roll (2) kept it small. Not the kill line.
